orchestrator.title: Let's get your store ready
orchestrator.description: We're picking up where you left off.

verifyEmail.title: Check your inbox
verifyEmail.description: We sent a verification link to your email address. Click it to unlock your merchant dashboard.
verifyEmail.whatHappensNext: After verifying your email, come back here and click the button below. The setup will continue automatically.
verifyEmail.resendMessage: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
verifyEmail.yourEmailHasntVerifiedYetPleaseCheckYour: Your email hasn't been verified yet. Please check your inbox and click the verification link.
verifyEmail.failedToResendVerificationEmailPleaseTry: Failed to resend the verification email. Please try again.

createStore.title: Create your store
createStore.description: Choose a name and a unique slug for your store. You can update these later.
createStore.slugTaken: That slug is already in use.
createStore.slugError: Could not verify slug availability. You can keep editing and retry.
createStore.slugEmpty: The slug is currently empty. You can keep editing it manually or use Reset to auto.
createStore.slugHint: Used in your store URL. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
createStore.draftRestored: We found your details from before. Feel free to review them before continuing.
createStore.storeNameMin: Store name must be at least 3 characters.
createStore.storeSlugMin: Store slug must be at least 3 characters.
createStore.storeSlugRegex: Slug must use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
createStore.storeCreationTemporarilyUnavailablePleas: Store creation is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
createStore.weWerenAbleCreateStoreRightNowPleaseChec: We weren't able to create your store right now. Please check the details and try again.
createStore.unableCreateStorePleaseTryAgain: Unable to create store. Please try again.
createStore.yourStoreCreationWillContinueBackgroundI: Your store creation will continue in the background. If something interrupts the flow, simply refresh the page to continue.

provisioning.everythingReady: Everything is set up and ready to go.
provisioning.offlineMessage: You are offline. Setup will resume when your connection returns.
provisioning.helpCheckAgain: Click "Check again" to see if setup has finished.
provisioning.helpProcessing: Your store creation is being processed — no need to resubmit it.
provisioning.helpAutoOpen: Once setup finishes, your dashboard will open automatically.
provisioning.helpContact: If things don't progress after a few attempts, reach out to our support team.
provisioning.stillSettingUp: Still setting up. We'll keep checking for you.
provisioning.takingLonger: Setup is taking a bit longer than usual. You can check again whenever you're ready.
provisioning.setupStopped: Setup stopped before the store became ready. You can try again below.
provisioning.checkError: We couldn't check the latest status. You can safely try again.

complete.addFirstProductDesc: Start building your catalog with a product listing.
complete.customizeStorefrontDesc: Choose a theme and style that fits your brand.
